name: ResonantImpact / dismemberment

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. A heavy hard bone and tendon snap followed by two short metallic resonant pings decreasing in pitch. Compact impact-driven severing with a recognizable double ring.
